# Draft:Battle for Charizard VMAX

----
Battle For Charizard VMAX (BFCV) is a slideshow web series created by the Scratch user 7788378. The first season was released on September 9th, 2025. It consists of 14 anthropomorphic objects competing for a Charizard VMAX Pokémon card. The second season, Battle For Illustrator Pikachu (BFIP) was released on November 12, 2025, Consisting of 12 objects competing to win an Illustrator Pikachu Pokémon card.
Characters
* Candy Corn is a piece of candy corn, being the first character to get an asset in the series.
* Cotton Candy is a piece of cotton candy, being the third character made for the show, despite being the second one with an asset drawn.
